rationale: CORRECTED conventions: spine + = forward, - = backward. spine=-18 was backward arch (PR-v3 misfire pattern, though PR-v3 comment for throne-sit was not in source — sign error of unknown origin); should be 0 for spine tall. leftShoulder=+15 and rightShoulder=-15 are asymmetric (opposite signs) — both should be 0 (T-pose, arms at sides) for symmetric square shoulders. Verified by buildPose: spine z=0.000, L elbow at x=-0.379, R elbow at x=+0.379 (symmetric ✓), L knee at x=-0.130, R knee at x=+0.130 (gap 0.26 = hip-width ✓). hipAbductL/R=-15 produced knees at gap 0.48 (wider than hip-width 0.26); hipAbduct=0 puts knees at hip-width gap exactly. shoulderFwdL=+7, shoulderFwdR=-5 preserved (minor asymmetry, not explicitly called out by description). Forearms flat along armrests CANNOT be perfectly achieved — rig limitation: elbow flexion is rotY (preserves y), wrist y is always 0.32 below elbow y; forearm will angle down. Acceptable approximation: arms hang at sides (elbow y=0.30, wrist y=-0.02) — typical throne pose with hands near lap.
